label: chunk-small-v4
_note: CHUNK-SIZE swap. NOT gold-compatible out of the box: new chunk boundaries -> new index ids -> v3 gold_chunk_id is invalid here. You must re-map gold to the v4 chunks by text overlap (see README) and run against that remapped gold set. Listed to show the shape; do not trust its numbers with v3 gold.
